name: 20010 · Washington, DC
findings: ZIP 20010 (Washington) has 216 nonprofit organizations. 104 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 89 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (12% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20010 (Washington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 20010 (Washington) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 57 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
